entities.name: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: On July 20, 1969, astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the Moon, while Michael Collins orbited above. The culmination of NASA's Apollo program and the Space Race with the Soviet Union, the Moon landing remains humanity's greatest technological achievement and a defining moment of the 20th century.
